execution: Only permitted private rustfmt parsing/formatting; no compiler/test/import/target/source/Git/public operation.
control root reservation: create_dir fails on preexistence without removal; receipt and completion-marker preexistence fail before reservation.
identity change: Drop refuses remove unless directory device/inode matches the reserved original; missing path is diagnostic error, not a claimed removal.
panic preservation: Root/Ring Drop have no unwrap/assert. Root writes only its owned receipt/marker and suppresses I/O errors, so original elapsed panic is not replaced. Missing/partial completion marker makes any diagnostic write/sync failure invalid in the outer controller.
counter failure rejection: Strict bool/int trace field validation, nonempty errors or cancellation rejected, both monotonic durations>=1700ms and internally ordered. Complete-marker requirement plus exact original elapsed panic source line/condition prevents arbitrary diagnostic failure from qualifying the baseline negative.
limits: Rustfmt validates parsing/formatting, not types/Send or runtime cleanup; those remain unexecuted until root review/grants. A stuck syscall/forced kill can prevent Drop completion; outer120s group watchdog plus required receipts rejects that outcome.
